import asyncio


# CASE py_bounded_pep_taskgroup expect=pass
async def map_with_concurrency[T](items: list[T], width: int, op) -> None:
    for offset in range(0, len(items), width):
        async with asyncio.TaskGroup() as group:
            for item in items[offset:offset + width]:
                group.create_task(op(item))


# CASE py_inorder_prelude_loop expect=fire
async def map_with_concurrency2(items, width, op):
    for offset in range(0, len(items), width):
        await asyncio.gather(*(op(item) for item in items[offset:offset + width]))
